youtube.title: He Paid $6.2 Million For A Banana (True Story) 🍌
youtube.description:
In December 2019 the Italian artist Maurizio Cattelan duct-taped a fresh banana to a wall at Art Basel Miami Beach and called it Comedian. Two editions sold for $120,000 each. Days later the artist David Datuna peeled it off the wall and ate it, and the gallery simply taped up a new one: the buyer owns a certificate of authenticity and instructions for display, and the banana is replaced when it goes off.

In 2023 a student in Seoul ate one at the Leeum Museum, saying he had skipped breakfast. On 20 November 2024 an edition sold at Sotheby's in New York for $6.2 million with fees, to the crypto entrepreneur Justin Sun, who ate the banana on stage in Hong Kong nine days later.

The banana itself came from a street fruit stand on the Upper East Side, where Shah Alam sold it for 25 cents.

Would YOU pay $6.2 million for a banana? 👇
